purpose: Prioritize and close scientific uncertainty through reproducible gates without converting missing evidence into claims.

gates.name: authority_provenance_and_freeze
pass_when: all consumed sources have authoritative origin
raw inputs are hash-bound
unknown rights remain fail-closed
no unresolved source identity is silently substituted
stop_when: source identity is ambiguous
raw hash changes without a new version
required covariance source cannot be identified

gates.name: structural_math_and_null_limit
pass_when: E2_at_z0_is_unity_within_declared_tolerance
E2_positive_on_declared_domain
analytic_and_numeric_derivatives_agree
RLL extra sector off recovers declared baseline
all equations declare units and domain
stop_when: null limit fails
unit ambiguity affects likelihood
two implementations disagree without explanation

gates.name: real_data_and_full_covariance_materialization
pass_when: data vectors and covariance dimensions agree
ordering is deterministic and tested
transformations are reversible or fully documented
all exclusions have explicit reasons
stop_when: covariance ordering cannot be proven
diagonal errors are substituted for an available full covariance without a declared ablation

gates.name: dataset_compatibility_before_joint_fit
pass_when: joint blocks are compatible under declared tests or explicitly branched
calibration and reconstruction choices are recorded
stop_when: joint likelihood would multiply blocks that failed compatibility without an explicit branch

gates.name: fair_baseline_tournament
pass_when: all models consume the same frozen data blocks appropriate to their domain
parameter and nuisance counts are explicit
AIC_AICc_BIC are recomputed from source likelihood outputs
stop_when: a comparator receives privileged data or covariance
parameter counting is inconsistent

gates.name: canonical_joint_likelihood
pass_when: PantheonPlus STAT+SYS is in the same canonical route when used
DESI covariance route is identical between models
likelihood components are hash-bound
stop_when: smoke settings are used for scientific model ranking
likelihood components differ between competitors without justification

gates.name: posterior_and_evidence_integrity
pass_when: convergence thresholds are preregistered and met
nested evidence uncertainty is recorded
multiple seeds do not change the scientific conclusion beyond declared tolerance
posterior collapse to null sector is explicitly diagnosed
stop_when: nonconverged chains are used for claims
Bayes evidence is reported without uncertainty
single-seed instability is material

gates.name: robustness_ablation_and_recovery
pass_when: known injected parameters are recovered within declared coverage
conclusions survive defensible variants or are explicitly scoped
failed and null tests remain versioned
stop_when: result exists only under one fragile prior or undocumented data choice

gates.name: physical_closure_and_perturbations
pass_when: background extension has a perturbatively defined completion
standard baseline is recovered before enabling RLL sector
no unstable region is hidden by parameter masking
stop_when: background-only fit is interpreted as a complete physical model
perturbation prescription is implicit

gates.name: growth_CMB_lensing_and_nonlinear_observables
pass_when: RLL predictions are generated from the same closed perturbation model
observables include covariance and systematics
stop_when: compressed CMB priors are presented as equivalent to full spectra
nonlinear claims are made without an explicit nonlinear prescription

gates.name: independent_replication
pass_when: a clean environment reproduces core numerical outputs within declared tolerances
at least one materially independent implementation or sampler crosschecks the model ranking
stop_when: replication reuses hidden local state
environment or input versions are unresolved

gates.name: publication_and_claim_router
pass_when: every promoted sentence maps to evidence
TOKEN_VAZIO remains visible
contradictions and unfavorable results are preserved
stop_when: publication language exceeds evidence state

initial_high_value_queue.reason: Current repository documents DESI covariance and Pantheon+ posterior paths as partially separated; unifying them removes a major model-ranking ambiguity.
Existing MCMC, dynesty and BIC-proxy results must be regenerated from one frozen likelihood/prior manifest before comparison.
Tests whether posterior collapse and model preference are pipeline behavior, prior behavior, or data-driven.
Required before f_sigma8, CMB and lensing can test RLL as more than a background parametrization.
Converts internal reproducibility into externally meaningful evidence and detects hidden implementation dependence.
